steps.title: Open the Website
steps.instruction: Navigate to the website you want to add to your home screen using Safari.

steps.title: Open the Share Menu
steps.instruction: Tap the Share icon (a square with an arrow pointing up) at the bottom of the screen.

steps.title: Select 'Add to Home Screen'
steps.instruction: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen' from the list of options.

steps.title: Confirm and Add
steps.instruction: Edit the name if desired, then tap 'Add' in the top right corner.

steps.title: Open the Website
steps.instruction: Go to the website you want to bookmark using Chrome.

steps.title: Open the Share Menu
steps.instruction: Tap the Share icon (three dots or a square with an arrow) at the top right.

steps.title: Select 'Add to Home Screen'
steps.instruction: In the share sheet, scroll and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.

steps.title: Confirm and Add
steps.instruction: Edit the name if you wish, then tap 'Add'.

steps.title: Open the Website
steps.instruction: Navigate to the website you want to add using Chrome.

steps.title: Open the Menu
steps.instruction: Tap the three dots menu icon in the top right corner.

steps.title: Select 'Add to Home screen'
steps.instruction: Tap 'Add to Home screen' from the menu.

steps.title: Confirm and Add
steps.instruction: Edit the name if needed, then tap 'Add'.

steps.title: Open the Website
steps.instruction: Go to the website you want to add using Microsoft Edge.

steps.title: Open the Menu
steps.instruction: Tap the three dots menu icon at the bottom center.

steps.title: Select 'Add to Home screen'
steps.instruction: Tap 'Add to Home screen' from the menu options.

steps.title: Confirm and Add
steps.instruction: Edit the shortcut name if you wish, then tap 'Add'.
